subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should `model.call.*` remain request-scoped, or should OpenClaw intentionally redefine it as a request-or-opaque-turn union for CLI runtimes?
rationale: Tests can prove lifecycle consistency, but they cannot choose the permanent diagnostics API and exporter semantics that existing sinks and dashboards must consume.

options.title: Keep model calls request-only
options.body: Introduce a distinct CLI/agent-turn diagnostic and span while preserving all existing `model.call.*` consumers and metrics as request-scoped.

options.title: Approve a versioned union contract
options.body: Adopt request-or-turn semantics only with explicit diagnostics-owner approval, complete consumer auditing, compatibility documentation, and migration tests.

recommendation.title: Keep model calls request-only
recommendation.body: Introduce a distinct CLI/agent-turn diagnostic and span while preserving all existing `model.call.*` consumers and metrics as request-scoped.

likelyOwner.reason: Their shipped observability work and current diagnostics ownership trail make them the strongest available owner for the telemetry-contract choice.
